text:
Tori: quick heads-up — spotted a broken internal link in the runtime guide that causes the 'model-onboarding' anchor to 404 when you click from the onboarding page. might block the canary doc rollout if we don't fix it.
Sam: ah thanks. where's the offending href?
Tori: it's in docs/runtime/faq.md line under 'Getting Started' — anchor is `#model-onboarding` but the target file uses `#model-onboarding-v2`.
Alina: can someone make a tiny PR to update the link or add a redirect? low risk.
Tori: small sed fix would do. example: `git checkout -b fix/docs/runtime-link && sed -i 's/#model-onboarding/#model-onboarding-v2/g' docs/runtime/faq.md && gh pr create --fill`
Sam: I can do the PR in ~30m, unless someone else is on it. pinging @Matt if he's already handling docs rollups.
Matt: not on this one, go ahead @Sam :thumbsup:
Sam: starting now. I'll also add a one-line note in the changelog and link to the source of truth.
docs-bot: created ticket DOCS-421 (priority: P3) and linked to thread.
Alina: thanks Sam — can you cc me on the PR? want to run a quick link-check workflow after merge.
Sam: will do. I'll include the CI check and request a small review from @Alina.
Tori: awesome. after merge, can someone run the site preview and confirm the onboarding page anchor works from the main nav? just want to be sure the redirect/canonical is okay.
Sam: noted — I'll verify preview and post back with the preview URL.
Alina: also, if this kind of mismatch is common, can we add a lightweight lint to the docs CI that fails on internal broken anchors? I can open a follow-up RFC.
Tori: love that. follow-up ticket would be great. for now, thanks everyone — small ops but feels urgent for the canary. :rocket:
